name: Notion Thief
oracle_text:
Flash
If an opponent would draw a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, instead that player skips that draw and you draw a card.
blocked_sentences: If an opponent would draw a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, instead that player skips that draw and you draw a card.

needs.what: a replace_draw mode that, for each draw by an affected player (affects_player: opponent, honouring except_first_in_draw_step), cancels that player's draw and has the static's controller draw a card instead -- e.g. a `draw_instead_by: "controller"` key beside affects_player
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_draw only carries draw_multiplier (loader refuses below 2) and replacements.draw multiplies the same player's draw; nothing skips the drawer's draw and gives the card draw to a different player. draw_limit drops draws past a cap but gives nothing to the controller, and a draw trigger would not stop the opponent's draw
